svg.aria-label: Where black tailed deer are through the year. Spring: logged openings with new green food. Summer: some move up, even to subalpine. Fall, your hunt: the rut; snow up high pushes them down. Winter: old growth and steep south to west slopes. Snow deeper than 30 cm is hard going.
svg.text: Where they are through the year
